title: HydraFacial
caption: A HydraFacial is a machine-based facial that runs three steps in one pass: it exfoliates dead skin cells, extracts debris from pores using suction, and pushes a serum into the skin at the same time. Unlike many clinical treatments, there's no recovery period — redness usually clears within hours. The results are real but temporary: most people need regular sessions to maintain them, because the machine isn't changing your skin's underlying biology. Knowing that helps you judge whether a course of treatments fits your actual goal. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae

slides.headline: Three steps, one pass
slides.sub: Exfoliation, pore extraction, and serum delivery happen simultaneously.

slides.headline: No real downtime
slides.sub: Most redness settles within hours — no peeling, no hiding indoors.

slides.headline: Results are real but temporary
slides.sub: The machine doesn't change your skin's biology — maintenance sessions matter.

slides.headline: The serum varies
slides.sub: Clinics swap in different serums — brightening, hydrating, or acne-targeted.

slides.headline: Know your actual goal
slides.sub: A one-off glow differs from treating a persistent skin concern over time.
